_comment: invent.c sortloot() and sortloot_cmp(): loot_classify() runs lazily inside the comparator and marks each object encountered (o_init.c observe_object()), so the order of discoveries within a class follows the order in which the recorder's qsort() first compares objects. The patched program's nh_deterministic_qsort() sorts with glibc's top-down merge sort, which compares the second and third of the first three items before the first. A blindfolded Valkyrie wishes for two armor pieces that she cannot see, swaps them to letters a and c, takes the blindfold off, lists her inventory and then pages through her discoveries. Independent of the c-diff-b4 examples.
